_comment: Voiceover script. Text here is the exact spelling used for the subtitles. Edit voices below to swap who speaks; run ./rebuild_with_elevenlabs.sh (or ./rebuild_audio.sh) afterwards.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: If you dig a tunnel under the entire Great Wall of China, you have the world's longest subway. Sort of.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the mountains are solid rock. So you bring a giant tunnel-boring machine, and a bulldozer to clear the mess.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the tunnel caves in behind it. So the machine places concrete rings as it goes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the wall goes up and down steep mountains, and trains can't climb that. So you dig deep under the peaks with gentle slopes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the Great Wall is over twenty-one thousand kilometers long. So you add a snack car, beds and a tiny cinema.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Congratulations, you built the world's longest subway.

narrator.description: Calm, friendly, a little playful, quick pace, neutral accent.

elevenlabs.voice_name: Elena Wren - Friendly, warm and kind, with neutral accent (library voice)

john.description: John, very old: slow, shaky voice.

elevenlabs.voice_name: The Lesser Poet (library voice, a real 81-year-old)
